title: Errors
generic: Unable to complete the operation. Please try again.
network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
timeout: The request took too long. Please try again.
serverError: The server ran into a problem. Please try again shortly.
forbidden: You don’t have permission to perform this action.
notFound: The requested record could not be found.
duplicate: A record with the same details already exists.
conflict: This record was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
invalidState: This action isn’t available in the record’s current status.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
emailNotConfirmed: Your email address hasn’t been confirmed yet. Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
weakPassword: This password is too weak. Choose a stronger password.
tokenExpired: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
accountPending: Your account is awaiting approval by HR.
accountDisabled: Your account has been disabled. Contact HR for assistance.
accountRejected: Your registration was not approved. Contact HR for assistance.
fileTooLarge: The file is larger than the allowed size.
uploadFailed: The file couldn’t be uploaded. Please try again.
downloadFailed: The file couldn’t be downloaded. Please try again.
exportFailed: The export couldn’t be generated. Please try again.
importFailed: The import couldn’t be completed. Review the error report and try again.
pdfFailed: The PDF couldn’t be generated. Please try again.
notConfigured: This feature hasn’t been configured yet.
inUse: This item is in use and can’t be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
lastSuperAdmin: The last Super Admin can’t be removed or disabled.
insufficientBalance: The leave balance is insufficient for this request.
overlappingLeave: This period overlaps with another leave request.
employeeNotLinked: Your account isn’t linked to an employee record yet. Contact HR.
pageErrorDescription: An unexpected error occurred while loading this page.
invalidReference: A related record no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
samePassword: Choose a password that's different from your current one.
signupDisabled: Self-registration is currently turned off. Contact HR.
